# Scene Setup

## Scene Hierarchy (Generated by Setup Wizard)

```
Scene Root
├── [VirtualMuseumManager]          — Singleton lifecycle manager
├── [MuseumSystems]                 — All manager scripts
│   ├── RoomManager
│   ├── LightingController
│   ├── AmbientAudioManager
│   ├── PerformanceMonitor
│   ├── TextureQualityManager
│   ├── OcclusionCullingManager
│   └── ExhibitDatabase
├── [XR Origin (XR Rig)]           — Player VR rig
│   ├── Camera Offset
│   │   ├── Main Camera
│   │   ├── Left Controller
│   │   │   ├── Near-Far Interactor
│   │   │   └── MuseumHUD (wrist)
│   │   └── Right Controller
│   │       └── Near-Far Interactor
│   ├── Locomotion System
│   │   ├── Teleportation Provider
│   │   ├── Snap Turn Provider
│   │   └── ComfortSettings
│   ├── MonumentInspector
│   ├── MuseumTeleportManager
│   └── GuidedTourController
├── [Environment]                   — Generated room geometry
│   ├── Corridor
│   ├── Room_Iraq
│   ├── Room_Prague
│   ├── Room_Shards
│   └── Room_Aerial
├── [Exhibits]                      — Monument models + pedestals
│   ├── Exhibit_NahumShrine
│   │   ├── Pedestal (PedestalController)
│   │   ├── Monument (MonumentGrabInteractable)
│   │   ├── TriggerZone (ExhibitTriggerZone)
│   │   ├── InfoPanel (ExhibitInfoPanel)
│   │   └── SpatialAudio (SpatialAudioTrigger)
│   └── ...
├── [FadeOverlay]                   — Screen fade canvas
├── [Lighting]                      — Baked + dynamic lights
├── [MainMenu]                      — VR main menu canvas
└── [WaypointIndicator]            — Tour arrow indicator
```

## Creating New Scenes

1. Duplicate the main scene
2. Modify room configurations in the Inspector
3. Re-bake lighting for each scene
